name: Bound
description: Bound MCP helps users inspect Bound account balances, payment recipients, payments, FX orders, indicative exchange rates, and upcoming settlements through read-only Public API tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bound.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bound MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bound provides these MCP tools: get_balance, get_live_rate, get_order, get_payment, get_recipient, list_balances, list_orders, list_payments, list_recipients, and list_upcoming_settlements.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bound?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bound in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Bound requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bound is developed by Bound. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
